name: MTTSL
recent: MTTSL 近期出现大股东 Aberdeen 系连续多日的持股变动申报，同时 CFO 与执行主席也有股权交易记录。公司在 11 月 4 日召开 EGM 并通过关联交易股东授权，另有一批 ESOS 新股在 11 月 2 日上市。
notable: Aberdeen 系大股东在 10 月底至 11 月初连续多日申报持股变动。
公司于 11 月 4 日召开 EGM，股东以 100% 票数通过关联交易股东授权。
ESOS 行使发行 1,325,100 股新股，已于 11 月 2 日上市。
risks: CFO 在 8 月至 10 月间分四笔减持共 50,000 股。
Aberdeen 系大股东连续多日申报持股变动，具体增减方向未在标题中显示。
ESOS 新股发行带来轻微股本扩大。
earnings: 2026 年 6 月 30 日止季度营收 3.604 亿令吉，净利 9,451 万令吉，净利率 26.2%；营收环比增 20.8%，净利环比增 44.5%，净利率高于上季的 21.9%。

recent_en: MTTSL recently saw consecutive days of shareholding change filings by Aberdeen-related substantial shareholders, alongside share dealings by its CFO and Executive Chairman. The company held an EGM on 4 Nov and passed a shareholders' mandate for recurrent related party transactions, while a batch of ESOS new shares was listed on 2 Nov.
notable_en: Aberdeen-related substantial shareholders filed consecutive shareholding change notices from late Oct to early Nov.
The company held an EGM on 4 Nov where shareholders passed the related party transaction mandate with 100% approval.
1,325,100 new ESOS shares were issued and listed on 2 Nov.
risks_en: The CFO disposed a total of 50,000 shares in four tranches between Aug and Oct.
Aberdeen-related substantial shareholders filed consecutive shareholding change notices; the direction of change is not shown in the titles.
The ESOS new share issuance results in a slight share capital expansion.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 June 2026, revenue was MYR 360.4 million and net income was MYR 94.5 million, with a net margin of 26.2%; revenue rose 20.8% QoQ and net income rose 44.5% QoQ, with net margin higher than 21.9% in the prior quarter.
